title: Fajr Rise
intro: An alarm that follows Fajr every day, and stops once you’re really up.

next.none: No alarm in the coming week

when.label: When
when.beforeFajr: {count, plural, one {# minute before Fajr} other {# minutes before Fajr}}
when.beforeSunrise: {count, plural, one {# minute before sunrise} other {# minutes before sunrise}}

notes.mind: Sums, or stars to tap in order
notes.steps: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} away from your bed
notes.shake: For when getting up is hard
notes.spot: A code you keep away from your bed

spot.missing: Scan a barcode or QR code you’ll keep away from your bed, like a tube of toothpaste in the bathroom.
spot.scanHint: Hold the code inside the frame.
spot.camera: Fajr Rise needs the camera to read the code. Nothing is recorded.

stillUp.label: Ask “Still up?”
stillUp.note: Five minutes later. If it goes unanswered, the alarm rings again.
stillUp.title: Still up?

test.done: Lock your phone. It rings in 10 seconds.

permissions.notifications: Turn on notifications so the alarm can ring.
permissions.exact: The alarm may ring a few minutes late on this phone. Allow exact timing?
permissions.fullScreen: Allow the alarm to show over the lock screen when it rings.
permissions.unavailable: This version of the app can’t ring alarms on this phone yet.
permissions.alarms: Allow Al-Murshid to ring alarms, so Fajr Rise sounds even in silent mode.
permissions.alarmsDenied: Alarms are off for Al-Murshid. Turn them on in Settings.
permissions.ios: Fajr Rise needs iOS 26 or later on this iPhone.
permissions.city: Fajr Rise needs your city to know when Fajr is.

privacy: The camera and motion sensors stay on your phone. Nothing is recorded or sent.
mercy: You can always turn it off: hold Turn off for 10 seconds.

ring.notificationBody: It’s time to wake for Fajr.
ring.fajrUntil: Fajr is here until sunrise at {time}.
ring.stillUpSoon: In five minutes, we’ll ask if you’re still up.

stars.repeat: Now tap them in the same order

walk.permission: Fajr Rise needs motion access to count your steps.

scan.prompt: Go to your spot and scan its code
scan.wrong: That’s a different code. Find the one you saved.

offer.title: Wake for Fajr?
offer.body: Fajr Rise follows Fajr every day, and keeps ringing until you’re really up.
